claims: Patriots' Day 2026 is on Monday, April 20, 2026.
Patriots' Day is a state holiday in Massachusetts and Maine.
Patriots' Day commemorates the Battles of Lexington and Concord.
Patriots' Day is held on the third Monday of April.
The 130th Boston Marathon is held on Monday, April 20, 2026.
The Battle of Lexington reenactment occurs on Saturday, April 18, 2026, at 5 AM on the Lexington Battle Green.
On Patriots' Day 2026 in Massachusetts, state, county, and municipal offices, public schools, and the RMV are closed.
On Patriots' Day 2026 in Massachusetts, federal offices, post offices, banks, retail stores, and restaurants are generally open.
On Patriots' Day 2026, the MBTA will run on a regular weekday schedule, with some modifications for buses.
The Lexington Parade is scheduled to stream live on April 18, 2026.
Concord is hosting special events marking the nation's 250th anniversary leading up to the 2026 celebrations.
A separate "Patriots Day Parade" takes place in Laguna Beach, CA, on March 14, 2026.
